title: State that alters character image in battle

posts.author: BB45
posts.body:
I am using a picture to display my character in front-view battles. I would like the picture to change to an "off-balance" variant whenever it is affected by the state "off-balance". I thought to use a common event tied to the state like I would with a skill for example but it seems like I cannot use a common event for "states". For now, I've been using this work-around in a battle event page with the
Conditions: Turn end
and
Span: Turn
JavaScript:
◆If：Player is affected by off-balance
  ◆Erase Picture：#1
  ◆Show Picture：#2, player_off_balance
  ◆
：Else
  ◆Erase Picture：#2
  ◆Show Picture：#1, player_normal
  ◆
：End
It seems to work as intended except when the "off-balance" state wears off, the picture change to "player_normal" is being delayed towards the turn end, due to the condition trigger. So the question is how do I make the picture change as soon as the state is removed, or even taking one step back, is there a better way to make this whole "state affects player picture so long as state is active" thing to work properly?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
You would use a plugin that executes code when the state is added and removed.
My Eval Tags can do that, linked in my signature; or if you're already using VisuStella plugins, their Skills and States Core has notetags for that.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
You added a semicolon at the end of the
if (stuff)
line.
That's incorrect, and you'll notice it wasn't there before.
Semicolons go at the end of a command. So by placing it there, you are saying the one command that gets done after the if is evaluated is nothing. Then the next lines of code are just there, they're not inside the if.
